note: The Williams household on the 1911 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. The return gives only Clare Valley; Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1910-11 prints 'The Bungalow, Williams Frederick Howard, lace manufacturer' on Clare Valley, and The Bungalow is the record's Ribble Lodge (#65), so on A. Hagues's decision they are filed there. Ribble Lodge held no census record for any year, and none of the three was in the record. By 1913-14 The Bungalow was Bernard Hardstaff's. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1911 census, Clare Valley, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1910-11, page 69 (Leicester Special Collections id 165745).
